import gzip, hashlib, io, json, urllib.parse, urllib.request
import pysam
ENCODE_URL = "https://encode-public.s3.amazonaws.com/2021/02/01/355cd23e-dc72-498f-9d8a-ac5b7f64e9f1/ENCFF717TCQ.bed.gz"
VCF_URL = "https://1000genomes.s3.amazonaws.com/1000G_2504_high_coverage/working/20201028_3202_raw_GT_with_annot/20201028_CCDG_14151_B01_GRM_WGS_2020-08-05_chr1.recalibrated_variants.annotated.vcf.gz"
BASES = {"A","C","G","T"}
def get_bytes(url):
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent":"Galaxy-UDT/1.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:
        return r.read()
peak_rows = []
with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=io.BytesIO(get_bytes(ENCODE_URL))) as fh:
    for raw in fh:
        if not raw.strip() or raw.startswith(b"#"):
            continue
        f = raw.decode().rstrip("\n").split("\t")
        if len(f) < 9:
            raise RuntimeError("ENCODE input is not narrowPeak-like")
        peak_rows.append((float(f[8]), f[0], int(f[1]), int(f[2])))
if len(peak_rows) < 1000:
    raise RuntimeError("ENCODE file has fewer than 1000 peaks")
peak_rows.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1], x[2], x[3]))
top = peak_rows[:1000]
chr1_intervals = sorted((s,e) for q,c,s,e in top if c == "chr1")
if not chr1_intervals:
    raise RuntimeError("No chr1 peaks among top 1000")
merged = []
for s,e in chr1_intervals:
    if not merged or s > merged[-1][1]:
        merged.append([s,e])
    elif e > merged[-1][1]:
        merged[-1][1] = e
common_positions = set()
ucsc_records = 0
for s,e in merged:
    params = urllib.parse.urlencode({"genome":"hg38","track":"snp151Common","chrom":"chr1","start":s,"end":e})
    req = urllib.request.Request("https://api.genome.ucsc.edu/getData/track?" + params, headers={"User-Agent":"Galaxy-UDT/1.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:
        data = json.load(r)
    recs = data.get("snp151Common", [])
    ucsc_records += len(recs)
    for rec in recs:
        alleles = rec.get("observed", "").split("/")
        if len(alleles) == 2 and len(set(alleles)) == 2 and all(a in BASES for a in alleles):
            pos = int(rec["chromStart"]) + 1
            if s <= pos - 1 < e:
                common_positions.add(pos)
if not common_positions:
    raise RuntimeError("No qualifying UCSC common SNP positions")
vf = pysam.VariantFile(VCF_URL)
samples = sorted(list(vf.header.samples))
if len(samples) != 3202:
    raise RuntimeError("Expected 3202 samples, found %d" % len(samples))
sample_index = {name:i for i,name in enumerate(vf.header.samples)}
order = [sample_index[name] for name in samples]
rows = []
seen = set()
for s,e in merged:
    for rec in vf.fetch("chr1", s, e):
        pos = rec.pos
        if pos not in common_positions:
            continue
        if len(rec.ref) != 1 or rec.ref not in BASES:
            continue
        if rec.alts is None or len(rec.alts) != 1 or len(rec.alts[0]) != 1 or rec.alts[0] not in BASES:
            continue
        key = (pos, rec.ref, rec.alts[0])
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        vals = list(rec.samples.values())
        calls = []
        for i in order:
            gt = vals[i].get("GT")
            if gt == (0,0):
                calls.append("0/0")
            elif gt == (0,1) or gt == (1,0):
                calls.append("0/1")
            elif gt == (1,1):
                calls.append("1/1")
            else:
                calls.append("./.")
        rows.append((pos, rec.ref, rec.alts[0], calls))
vf.close()
rows.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1], x[2]))
with open("genotypes.tsv", "w", newline="") as out:
    out.write("\t".join(["CHROM","POS","REF","ALT"] + samples) + "\n")
    for pos,ref,alt,calls in rows:
        out.write("\t".join(["chr1",str(pos),ref,alt] + calls) + "\n")
with open("genotypes.tsv", "rb") as fh:
    content = fh.read()
md5 = hashlib.md5(content).hexdigest()
line_count = content.count(b"\n")
if not content.endswith(b"\n") or line_count != len(rows) + 1:
    raise RuntimeError("Output line validation failed")
with open("qc.txt", "w") as q:
    q.write("top_peaks=1000\n")
    q.write("chr1_top_peak_rows=%d\n" % len(chr1_intervals))
    q.write("chr1_merged_intervals=%d\n" % len(merged))
    q.write("ucsc_records_examined=%d\n" % ucsc_records)
    q.write("qualifying_common_positions=%d\n" % len(common_positions))
    q.write("samples=%d\n" % len(samples))
    q.write("variant_rows=%d\n" % len(rows))
    q.write("lines=%d\n" % line_count)
    q.write("md5=%s\n" % md5)
    q.write("answer=%d;%s\n" % (line_count, md5))
